parent_v10.key_result: identical A/B/M/G and nodewise marginal maps hid different pairwise relations, first-passage histories and knockout responses in 192/192 replicates

scientific_question: Once static nodewise representation is known to be insufficient, what is the exact minimum relational information needed to identify each declared topology-sensitive ecological target?

targets.pairwise_relation: complete directed reachability signature among ordered active-node pairs
targets.intervention: reachable-active-node count after every single non-source node knockout
targets.critical_node_count: number of non-source nodes whose removal disconnects at least one additional active node

atomic_relational_measurements.static_nodewise_features: not included in optimization because v10 proved them exactly constant across the four worlds

exact_sufficiency_rule: a selected feature set is sufficient for target T when any two worlds with identical selected-feature signatures also have identical T values

optimization.method: exact minimum-cardinality search after deduplicating atomic measurements that induce the same partition of the four worlds
optimization.tie_rule: lexicographically smallest measurement-ID tuple among minimum-cardinality solutions

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every row's pairwise-relation, first-passage, intervention and critical-node-count targets are exactly resolvable by the complete REL/FP/KO measurement library.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any target family with at least one unresolved row.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every row and each of pairwise-relation, first-passage and intervention targets, the exact minimum measurement count is strictly smaller than the total number of available atomic relational measurements.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately if any target/row requires the entire atomic library.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: In every row, both the first-passage target and intervention target induce fewer equivalence classes than the four full topology identities.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately if either target has four classes in any row.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row has different exact minimum measurement counts or different canonical minimum feature sets for pairwise-relation, first-passage and intervention targets.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if all three target families always have identical minima and canonical feature sets.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row has a minimum target design that uses an atomic measurement from a different semantic family than the target itself, for example KO evidence identifying a first-passage target or REL evidence identifying an intervention target.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every minimum design always uses only same-family measurements.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every row's joint relational suite is resolvable by REL/FP/KO measurements even though no raw edge-list observation is supplied.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if any row's joint suite remains unresolved.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row has fewer joint-relational-suite target classes than the four distinct edge-topology worlds.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the joint target always identifies all four topology worlds.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across rows and target families, the lexicographically canonical exact minimum designs use more than one distinct first measurement ID.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if one fixed measurement is always the canonical first measurement.

secondary_outputs: rows where target resolution leaves two or more topology worlds equivalent
joint-suite compression relative to full edge identity
claim_boundary: Atomic measurement counts are conceptual information counts, not field-cost-equivalent operations.
The exact minima are conditional on the four v10 topology archetypes and their labeled nodes.
A target-sufficient relational summary is not a claim that omitted topology is biologically irrelevant for every other question.
The programme does not claim novelty for finite partition refinement or exact set-cover search.
stop_rules: Do not add atomic measurement types after scoring.
Do not remove a target family after scoring.
Do not assign post hoc unequal costs to rescue a preferred measurement family.
Do not use raw edge-list queries in v11.
